target.name: Interaction_DispatchTargetState
target.operation: push longword from (A0, selector * 4) and tail-transfer through RTS

boundary_basis: The helper begins at the previously unknown entry 0x001B0316 and ends immediately before the shared RTS at 0x001B0334.
Its indexed longword push is a computed control transfer rather than ordinary data movement.
The selector convergence service at 0x001B02EC updates the same selector byte before the dispatch helper consumes it.
